summary: Payment providers sometimes send the same event twice. Now the app remembers handled events and skips repeats, so a customer is charged once.

userQuotes.text: Customers got charged twice. Find out why and fix it.

why.narrative: The webhook handler processed every event, even repeats.

decisions.choice: Store handled event IDs in the database
decisions.reason: Survives restarts and works across servers.

timeline
  14:02 : You report double charges
  14:35 : This commit

changes.title: The app now remembers which events it has handled
changes.before: Every event was processed, even a repeat.
changes.after: The handler saves the event ID first and skips repeats.

howItWorks.narrative: A new ID goes on to charge; a repeat is acknowledged and skipped. See `src/webhooks/handler.ts:31`.

  Handler-->>Provider: 200 OK

effects: Customers are charged once per payment.
